game_title: Examination practice · Branch Assembly 9 · Merge Endpoint
game_concept: A action defense set in Sand Dunes – Scarab Burrow, a scarab burrow: the caravan guide must handle desert bandits while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Edge Case Hunter: Find inputs like 0, empty lists, and negative numbers that break otherwise correct code.
theme: Sand Dunes – Scarab Burrow: a scarab burrow
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Week 5 examination practice: Source organization: build a valid C source file that prints 28. Put preprocessing before main; keep declarations and statements inside its body. Then test its compiler-factory route: Build the splitter at (2, 3), with the upper processing path on row 0 and lower path on row 5. Alternate items between A (upper) and B (lower); wait if the scheduled branch is blocked. Assemble components on both paths, then merge them at (8, 3) before the shared output. Deliver exactly 11 components (6 upper, 5 lower). Set the gold-socket controller batch to 11.
controls: Drag sprites onto the grid. R rotates new pieces. Set fork output directions and router conditions in the inspector. Splitters alternate; routers evaluate each item; mergers accept one waiting item at a time fairly. Set batch size, connect power, repair rounded conveyors, then Run or Step. Grid controls are the keyboard alternative.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Edge Case Hunter' (Week 9 slot 9), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Scarab Burrow'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: C Components, Keywords, Preprocessor and Organization

region.name: Sand Dunes

source_player_objective: Protect the palm grove from desert bandits in Scarab Burrow: keep the edge_cases meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 76-second timer ends.
source_lose_condition: edge_cases drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 76-second timer ends.

hint: Alternate items between A (upper) and B (lower); wait if the scheduled branch is blocked. Assemble components on both paths, then merge them at (8, 3) before the shared output.
